title: VTODO COMPLETED Timestamp Lifecycle on Status Transitions in Add and Edit Operations

citations.verbatim_quote: Conformance: The property can be specified in a "VTODO" calendar component. The value MUST be specified as a date with UTC time. Description: This property defines the date and time that a to-do was actually completed.

rationale: RFC 5545 Section 3.8.2.1 defines COMPLETED as a UTC DATE-TIME recording when a VTODO was actually completed. As a calendar store lifecycle policy (STORE_POLICY), the store automatically synchronizes a VTODO's `completed` timestamp with its `status` transitions: adding or editing a VTODO to `COMPLETED` status (when `completed` is not explicitly provided) sets `completed` to the operation's UTC `dtstamp`; editing an already-completed VTODO without changing its status preserves its original `completed` timestamp; and transitioning `status` away from `COMPLETED` clears `completed` to None.
store_implication: On VTODO `add`: if `completed` is not explicitly set and `status == COMPLETED`, set `completed = dtstamp` (in UTC). On VTODO `edit`: if `status` is specified in the edit patch and `completed` is not explicitly specified: (a) if the stored VTODO's prior `status` was not `COMPLETED` and the new `status` is `COMPLETED`, set `completed = dtstamp`; (b) if the stored VTODO had a `completed` timestamp and the new `status` is not `COMPLETED`, clear `completed` to None; (c) if both the prior and new `status` are `COMPLETED`, preserve the existing `completed` timestamp.
edge_cases_and_counterexamples: If a caller explicitly provides both `status=COMPLETED` and an explicit `completed` UTC timestamp on add or edit, the explicit `completed` timestamp must be preserved rather than overwritten with `dtstamp`.
Re-editing an already-completed VTODO (e.g., updating its summary while `status` remains `COMPLETED`) must NOT overwrite the existing `completed` timestamp with the new edit's `dtstamp`.

When editing a single occurrence (`Range.NONE`) of a recurring VTODO to `status=COMPLETED`, the forked override VTODO receives `completed=dtstamp` while the recurring master VTODO remains `NEEDS-ACTION` with `completed=None`.

scenarios.name: todo_status_transition_manages_completed_timestamp
scenarios.description: Marking a VTODO COMPLETED sets completed=dtstamp, and reverting status to NEEDS-ACTION clears completed=None.
